blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time, the City Tour of Bogotá's historic center, also known as "La Candelaria," will begin. The tour includes a visit to the Gold Museum, where you'll see nearly 34,000 pieces of pre-Hispanic gold and over 25,000 pre-Columbian artifacts. Next, you'll visit the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Donation, where works by the renowned Colombian artist Fernando Botero, known internationally for his painting, drawing, and sculpture techniques, are exhibited. The tour will continue with a panoramic view of Bolívar Square (including the Primatial Cathedral, Casa de Nariño, Liévano Palace, and the Palace of Justice). The day will conclude with an ascent to Monserrate. Return to the hotel for accommodation.
Duration: 6 hours
Includes: Professional tour guide in Spanish, private transportation, entry to the Gold Museum, Casa de la Moneda, and Botero Donation, and the ascent to Monserrate.
Important Note: The Gold Museum is closed on Mondays, and the Casa de la Moneda and Botero Donation are closed on Tuesdays

Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time, assistance at the hotel and departure to the town of Zipaquirá, passing through the so-called “Savannah of Bogotá”. Arrival at the Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral, one of the main tourist sites in Colombia, cataloged as the first wonder of Colombia built 180 meters deep in a salt mine.
Duration: 5 hours
Includes: Professional tour guide in English, private transportation, and an entrance to the Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral.
